decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system extends the firm's established office furniture line, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret market feedback and refine the models.
The chair family sits squarely within the firm's core seating and upholstery know-how, so it can be assimilated and improved readily.
The carpet-based floor cushions build on existing upholstery and textile knowledge, but as a niche accessory they carry somewhat higher risk of being pruned.
The designer-collaboration sofa from EOOS is core upholstery business that the firm understands well and promotes prominently.
The high standing table complements the firm's lounge and conference offer, uses familiar materials and processes, and is easy to manage.
The rug collection lies furthest from the firm's knowledge base, which limits learning from it, but its flagship status, links to the carpet cushions and the firm's own R&D argue for keeping it.
